newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car navigation likely int'l standard - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan car navigation likely int'l standard - paper.

text.p: The International Telecommunications Union (ITU) is likely to adopt the Japanese specification car navigation system as the international standard, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.

The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that if the Japanese specification was adopted as the international standard, this would help Japanese makers increase their export of car navigation systems.
The paper said the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications was in final negotiations with ITU members but the ministry was not immediately available for comment.
